The scheme is officially referred to as MGNREGS (Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme) — the "Act" (MGNREGA) is the law, and the "Scheme" (MGNREGS) is the programme run under that law; in everyday use, both names are used interchangeably.
